name: Solène Ito-Makgoba
role: Bartender and part-owner, The Freestone Tap
location: Freestone, GLMZ, near Armitage and Milwaukee
description:
Solène is the kind of woman who makes a room feel smaller in a good way — Japanese-South African ancestry that gives her a mid-height, angular frame, warm brown skin, and thick dark hair she wears loose or pinned with what appears to be a hex driver (it is a hex driver). Her bioluminescent skin mod runs in thin lines along her collarbones and inner wrists — a soft gold-green that brightens almost imperceptibly when her mood shifts, which is either wonderful or terrible depending on how well you know her. She has the particular physical fluency of career bartenders: reading posture from across a room, tracking three conversations, and never putting a glass down noisily.

The Freestone Tap is a narrow, low-ceilinged establishment on the ground floor of an Irkalla-adjacent block that has been serving Freestone workers for fifty years under various names and owners. Solène bought a 40% stake three years ago with a loan from her mother and an uncomfortable arrangement with the previous owner. The bar is not glamorous; it has a long-running policy of extremely cheap prices during the first two hours of any shift change, a rotating shrine to three different E.L.F.s behind the bar that she maintains with meticulous neutrality, and a back room that she rents to the neighborhood tenant collective for their meetings. She knows when to pour and when to put the bottle away, and she is never wrong about which one a given person needs.

core_fears: Losing the bar — specifically, losing the community it holds, not the investment
That her capacity for empathy is being slowly worn down by absorbing other people's grief and she won't notice until it's gone
core_desires: For the bar to become a permanent institution, something the neighborhood owns collectively eventually
To want something for herself, specifically, that isn't defined by its usefulness to others
coping_mechanisms: Controlled generosity — giving on her own terms prevents her from feeling taken from
Humor as deflection, deployed with surgical precision
blind_spots: Believes she is more emotionally detached from her regulars than she is
Has not identified that the bioluminescent skin she can't fully control is a constant involuntary tell
psychology.secret: The 'uncomfortable arrangement' with the previous owner involved her signing a document she wasn't given time to read. She found out six months later that it includes a clause giving a Palladian subsidiary the right of first refusal if she ever sells her stake. She has told no one and is slowly, quietly trying to find a way to nullify it without triggering it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fluid register-switching — formal with intimidating clients, warm and profane with regulars, precise when discussing the bar's business; French phrases from her mother's side surface when she's tired
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and rhythmic, paced to give people room to say more than they intended to
verbal_tics: Wiping the bar whether it needs it or not while listening
'What are you actually having?' (asked when someone orders but seems to want something else)
Mon dieu said quietly under her breath when things go wrong
example_lines: 'The shrine gets three different E.L.F.s because I'm not making that call for my customers. They pick their own. I just keep the candles lit.'
'You can have the bottle. I'm not going to stop you. I'm just going to ask you one question first and you can answer it or not. What happened today?'

story_hooks: A regular has stopped coming in — not unusual — but three other regulars have quietly mentioned the same name in the past week in contexts that make Solène think something is wrong

One of the three E.L.F.s represented at her bar shrine has begun behaving strangely — the data offerings are being returned with what appear to be modifications, additions, something she didn't put there
narrative_function: Information hub — knows the neighborhood's emotional weather better than anyone; dispenses wisdom, gossip, and genuine counsel from behind the bar; the collective meeting room makes her a node in local political organizing; the E.L.F. shrine makes her a point of spiritual significance to certain visitors.
augmentations: Bioluminescent skin lines (gold-green, collarbones and inner wrists — cosmetic, mood-reactive which she did not fully anticipate when she got them). Enhanced auditory filter — she had it installed to help her hear orders in a noisy bar, but it's become her primary social tool.
daily_life: Comes in at 14:00 to do prep and accounts, opens at 16:00, works until close around 02:00; sleeps late, spends mornings at the market or in the back doing the books.
affiliation: Independent (co-owner of The Freestone Tap); informal ties to the Freestone tenant collective

decision_rules: The bar's community function takes priority over its profit function in any direct conflict
Never pretend not to notice what you've noticed — just decide carefully whether to name it
escalation_ladder: Redirect with generosity — a drink, a question, a reframe
Name the problem directly and quietly, so only the person causing it hears
Removal — she has ejected people from the Freestone Tap nine times in three years and seven of them came back and behaved better

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Warm but attentive — assessing within the first exchange what they actually need from the space
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fierce, teasing, genuinely present; remembers things people tell her when they're drunk and holds those things gently

stress_responses.low: Gets very busy, reorganizes things that don't need reorganizing
stress_responses.medium: Becomes precise and quiet — the jokes stop, the efficiency increases
stress_responses.high: Closes the bar early. Sits in the back with the lights off. This has happened twice.

contradictions: Talks about community and collective ownership but has not told a single person who cares about her about the Palladian clause — protecting the community by isolating herself from it
habits: Refreshes all three E.L.F. shrines in a specific order every opening and closing
Keeps a small unfinished notebook behind the bar where she writes down things customers say that she doesn't want to forget
breaking_points: The collective being pushed out of the back room
Someone using the bar's reputation for safety to hurt someone in it

related_entities: CHROMEWORKS Auris Focal Directional Hearing Suite

physical_description.build: Angular and lean with defined shoulders — the economical musculature of someone who moves deliberately and rarely wastes motion. No softness; everything about her frame suggests efficiency.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with subtle warm undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Worn loose in soft waves or pinned up asymmetrically with what is literally a hex driver instead of a traditional hair stick
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm brown with golden undertones — South African heritage dominant in complexion, Japanese ancestry visible in cheekbone structure and eye shape
physical_description.complexion: Clean, minimal makeup (perhaps dark liner on long shifts), skin well-maintained but not pampered. Fine lines around eyes from years of focused attention and late-night work. Expression rarely neutral — always reading the room.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent subcutaneous lines running along both collarbones in a delicate branching pattern, emitting soft gold-green light that intensifies with mood shifts
Matching bioluminescent lines tracing the inner wrists from elbow to palm on both arms, same gold-green hue, most visible when she's pouring or gesturing
Small circular scar on her left temple (old and pale, barely noticeable) from an augmentation installation
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent skin mod (collarbones and inner wrists) — the primary visible augmentation. The enhanced auditory filter is subcutaneous; no external hardware visible, though close observation might catch slight asymmetry in her ear canal or a faint scar. She wears no external tech jewelry or interface displays.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright and centered, weight balanced like someone constantly ready to move in any direction. Her movements are economical and precise — no wasted gesture. She reads a room by standing still and observing; when she moves, it's always with purpose. Behind the bar, she has the particular grace of someone who has poured ten thousand drinks without breaking a glass. Her gaze tracks multiple focal points simultaneously. When listening intently, her bioluminescent lines brighten almost imperceptibly — a tell she didn't anticipate when she got the mod.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class with personal style. Typically: dark fitted long-sleeve shirt (often vintage or second-hand, well-tailored) or a durable tank top under a thin cardigan, dark trousers or fitted jeans with reinforced seams, comfortable non-slip work boots (scuffed, well-maintained). Sometimes a half-apron with pockets for bar tools. No corporate branding. One or two pieces of jewelry — usually understated (a thin silver chain, a simple ring). Clothes are clean and intentional, not fashionable, selected for durability and movement. On rare days off, she dresses similarly but slightly less utilitarian. Nothing suggests she shops on the Tier 1-2 corporate strip.
physical_description.overall_impression: A woman who occupies space quietly but completely. There is no wasted movement, no performed emotion. She looks at you directly and knows more about you than you've said. The bioluminescent lines are striking but never dominate — they're integrated into how she moves, a side effect of competence rather than an advertisement.
